turns.programMessage: Thank you for exploring that with me — noticing that a thought might be a distortion rather than plain fact can really open things up. Before our next session, I'd like you to practice noticing your automatic thoughts each day using the cognitive distortions list, and jot your own examples in its personal-examples column. In a future session, your therapist will introduce something called the Intrapersonal Thought Record, which will help you work with these thoughts even more deeply. Thank you for all the honest work you've done today — this was real progress.
